title: Accenture Technology Vision 2023: When Atoms meet Bits: The foundations of our new reality
notes: Four trends. Labels and subtitles from the contents page; quotes from the Introduction paragraph that describes each trend. Publication month not verified: surveys fielded December 2022 to January 2023; the readable PDF is a re-export dated 2023-06-21; trade press covered the report on 2023-03-31. Research Methodology: 'This year the trends look a decade into the future'. Survey figures were matched to statements by PDF word position (number printed before 'of global executives ...'); the raw text order is unreliable in this file.

entries.label: Digital identity
entries.quote: In digital identity we discuss how identity is the quiet catalyst of this next generation of innovation.
entries.subject: Digital identity
entries.note: Edition-level horizon: the Research Methodology says 'This year the trends look a decade into the future'. Printed subtitle: 'ID for everyone and everything'. Present-tense survey: 85% of executives agree digital identity is becoming a strategic business imperative (number matched by text order, not checked by position).

entries.label: Your data, my data, our data

entries.note: Edition-level horizon: the Research Methodology says 'This year the trends look a decade into the future'. Printed subtitle: 'Why transparency will become your most precious resource'. entries.label: Generalizing AI

entries.label: Our forever frontier
entries.quote: It explores how the feedback loop between science and technology is getting faster, with each accelerating the advancement of the other, in ways that begin to unlock the world’s grand challenges.
